Best place to chill and view the Dragon Bridge show
Apr 2018 • Couples
We needed a place away from the throngs of people at the marina to watch the Dragon Bridge so we settled for this. We weren't disappointed. The bar is chill, and provides you with a great view of the Da Nang cityscape.

And not to mention, they had a great tropical house playlist going on, and the prices were reasonable. Food was delicious, and the drinks menu was exotic - give it a go! 

The only downside is the service level when the places becomes packed, the staff gets easily overwhelmed and took forever to attend to people, or settle our bill.

Food good / Service worked slow
Mar 2018 • Family
We had a wonderful view from the boat. One of the best views you have in Da Nang to see all the bridges. If you want to see the Dragon Show, you have the best view from there. 
The food was good. We had the broken rice , the grill plate for 2 and the chicken curry. 
Service were slow and their english is not the best. Maybe new service members, but it took so long (about 50 min.) until they clean up our table. Also no one asked us if we needed something else. That was a bit disappointing. 

The manager is very friendly and brought us some fruits as an excuse because of the new service member. 

All in all it was very nice experience.

Comfortable place to chill at
Mar 2018 • Friends
It's located along the river, right next to the head of Dragon Bridge. I was there in the afternoon. It's definitely a place to relax and enjoy a cup of Saigon coffee. Drinking a cup of coffee, listening to the musice played in the lounge, watching the cars go and out, seeing the buildings opposites, also seeing the airplane taking off and landing, it worths to come. And I appreciate the waitress reminded me the coconut is cold because I told her I didn't want cold coffee at the begining. It's thoughtful and professional to rememeber my preference. Nice job. 

The coffee is not bad. Staff is friendly and speak English well which is a bonus in Vietnam.
